messages:
alex: Morning — quick async check. What I did / blockers / today:

alex: Did the debounce change for the alert pipeline late last night; saw ~30% drop in duplicate pages. Opened INFR-218 for the remaining noise.
priya: Nice, saw the drop on dash too :thumbsup:. Still seeing a handful of 504s tied to the batcher backlog during spikes.
sam: Re: 504s — I traced one to the autoscaler cooldown not kicking in fast enough. Follow-up PR ready, needs a review (CR: #3421). Pinged @maya for perf sign-off.
maya: On it — will do a quick perf pass this morning. FYI I repro'd the 504 locally with seq_len=2048 and small batch sizes.
alex: thx. blocker for me is getting the canary config updated so we can roll the autoscaler fix without flapping other tenants. Holding on the rollout until canary infra is green.
priya: For the canary, remember to bump the KV warmup to avoid cache churn. See runbook snippet I posted yesterday.

jim: Quick FYI from oncall: customer-reported increased latency for embeddings in eu-west around 03:10 UTC. I linked trace: https://internal/traces/xyz — looks like an overloaded replica.

alex: thanks @jim — that's likely related to the same batcher backlog. I'll route extra capacity to eu-west for the next 30m to stabilize.

ops-bot: incident created: INC-2026 "eu-west embeddings latency spike" assigned to jim, severity: P2.

sam: CR ping: #3421 ready for review (small change in autoscaler cooldown logic). test matrix green except flaky `TestBatcherEdge` — debugged but not fixed.

maya: I'll review CR after perf pass. For flaky test, can you paste failing logs? small snippet helps.
sam: failing log line: `ERROR: batcher timeout exceeded (120s) — backlog=312`. Repro command: `./scripts/run-batcher-test --seed=1234 --concurrency=8`.

priya: FYI I'm pairing with infra to add a light-weight metric for kv-ratio so we can alert earlier before cache thrash. Will be done today.

alex: Today's plan: finish canary config, coordinate capacity bump for eu-west, and start the autoscaler rollout once CRs + perf sign-off are in. Blockers: canary template needs one more env var (from security) — pinged @maya to loop in security if needed.

maya: I can add security alias to the canary env; will sync with sec later this morning.

jim: Oncall follow-ups: I'll update INC-2026 with timeline + mitigation. Also will post quick note in status channel if impact persists.

priya: quick ask — does anyone have bandwidth to look at alert debounce thresholds? I think 2 of our alerts are still too sensitive during small scale-ups.

alex: I can take a look after canary is green, grab the thresholds dashboard.

sam: tagging this thread for visibility :eyes: — CR pinged, perf review queued, oncall handling incident, autoscaler rollout gated on canary.

alex: thanks all. If anything urgent, DM me or @oncall. Otherwise we'll reconvene in async thread later — share small updates here.
